description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

Every day, millions of people use Instacart to get the essentials they need, and along the way they discover new ways to save and earn rewards. Our payments, loyalty, offers and retailer storefront teams power those moments, with a mission to make affordability and financial ease accessible to all through experiences that feel seamless and rewarding.

Instacart powers grocery shopping in two ways: the Instacart marketplace, where customers shop across many retailers in one app, and a white-label product that lets retailers run their own branded storefronts, loyalty programs and offers on our technology. This role sits on the team that designs the shared building blocks behind both, including offers, loyalty, payments and savings modules that retailers configure to create their own store experiences.

Our customers face real financial pressure, and our retail partners need flexible ways to express their brands. As loyalty and white-label storefronts grow, we need stronger guardrails, configurations and governance so work done once can be reused with confidence across consumers, retailers and brands.

This scope extends horizontally across both our primary marketplace and white-label solutions, flexing across workstreams while the work is still taking shape, then systemizing it: turning emerging patterns into well-crafted components, configurations and guidelines woven into product and tooling. The right candidate will work to ensure our retail partners and consumers have access to cutting-edge yet intuitive solutions for offers, discounts, loyalty programs.

About the Job

As a Senior Product Designer II on this platform, you’ll pair strong product judgment with deep craft in components and design language. Your focus is a kit of primitives and component foundations that deliver best-in-class experiences across loyalty, payments, savings and more, powering both the Instacart marketplace and the retailer storefronts built on our white-label offering. Through thoughtful design, you’ll bridge the gap between complex business goals and intuitive user experiences across offers to make the underlying system as thoughtful as the screens built on it.

Day-to-day, you’ll work with a multidisciplinary team to identify the key moments across the funnel (for example, loyalty on Storefront home vs. the cart) and design components structured to assemble into cohesive, scalable experiences. You’ll balance the needs of customers (transparency and simplicity), retailers (business growth and customer loyalty), and brands (ad campaigns and conversions).

  • Define the design language point of view for the retailer space: how storefronts, loyalty and offers express partner brands while staying consistent, accessible and trustworthy.
  • Define configurable components that serve many surfaces and partners through set options rather than custom builds.
  • Design the configuration layer that Professional Services, integrators and retailers use to set up components for their needs.
  • Build first versions of experiences end-to-end, from discovery through delivery, including problem framing, exploration, prototyping, validation, and handoff.
  • Flex across workstreams (loyalty, offers, retailer storefronts) while work is still taking shape, then systemize what you learn into patterns, components and guidelines.
  • Use AI-enhanced tools to accelerate component exploration, prototyping, documentation and help the team adopt those practices.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Research, Data Science and retail partners to shape requirements, and translate through clear storytelling and interactive prototypes.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years of professional experience in product design with a strong portfolio showcasing interaction design, visual craft and systems thinking.
  • Mastery of user-centric design processes, from concept ideation and prototyping to developer-ready assets.
  • Experience designing and shipping components that teams and partners can set up for different needs without custom builds, and working with engineering on how those components connect to the underlying data.
  • Proven ability to create seamless and scalable design systems that work across diverse surfaces (web, mobile apps, white-label platforms) and ship those patterns and configurations for a design system.
  • Experience supporting and defining guardrails, governance or configuration models for systems that multiple teams or partners build on, and balancing flexibility with cohesion.
  • Exceptional UI craft and a clear point of view on design language: hierarchy, density, motion and interaction quality, and how consistency creates trust and differentiation.
  • Proficiency in Figma, rapid prototyping and design-to-code workflows and daily hands-on AI use with a clear view of its strengths and limits.
  • Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex design ideas persuasively to diverse stakeholders.
  • A track record of working in ambiguous spaces and bringing clarity through design strategy and thoughtful execution.
  • 8+ years of professional experience in product design with a strong portfolio showcasing interaction design, visual craft and systems thinking.
  • Mastery of user-centric design processes, from concept ideation and prototyping to developer-ready assets.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in marketplace environments or designing for multi-sided ecosystems.
  • Experience with white-label, multi-brand or themeable products, where partners customize experiences within system constraints.
  • Experience designing for savings-focused or transactional products such as discounts, promotions, loyalty membership workflows.

#LI-remote

Instacart provides highly market-competitive compensation and benefits in each location where our employees work. This role is remote and the base pay range for a successful candidate is dependent on their permanent work location. Please review our Flex First remote work policy here. Currently, we are only hiring in the following provinces: Ontario, Alberta, British Columbia, and Nova Scotia.

Offers may vary based on many factors, such as candidate experience and skills required for the role. Additionally, this role is eligible for a new hire equity grant as well as annual refresh grants. Please read more about our benefits offerings here.
